externalSource.service: NetEase Cloud Music public API, platform-hosted contributor LRC
externalSource.track: N25 x KAITO full cover, SEKAI ALBUM vol.3

audioOffsetCheck.method: Decode public NetEase standard full album MP3 and selected Bili AAC to mono8000Hz; find normalized cross-correlation maxima within ±6s at six 12s windows. Positive offset means MV time = album time + offset. No duration scaling.
audioOffsetCheck.scope: Verifies audio-content constant offset, not accuracy of external LRC vocal timestamps.

offsetRule: MV time = source LRC time + median offset, no scaling. Tiny observed offset drift below 3 ms over song is below one 60 fps frame.
limits: Only line starts come from the external LRC; no enhanced word starts or explicit line ends were supplied by this public source.
126 normalized exact text matches establish correspondence, not vocal timing accuracy. Verify against actual selected MV/audio anchors.
Do not hold text until the next start across instrumental gaps; lines66,91 and126 need explicit end review.
Any interpolated word entrances or duration caps must remain labelled estimated.
No external lyric text is stored in this summary; user TSV remains authoritative.

externalDisplayClearCandidates.scope: Display-clear LRC blank timestamps only; NOT verified vocal ends. The NetEase markers can be much later than actual singing.
externalDisplayClearCandidates.suggestedAction: Use independently reviewed selected-MV subtitle/audio ends; otherwise duration caps must be marked estimated.
